dict.string: Caravan: the self-organizing agent. Identical on every node -- each instance decides for itself whether it's head or a tail and supervises the appropriate local process (llama-server or rpc-server). Replaces the per-role com.caravan.llama-server / com.caravan.rpc-server plists. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. Requires Homebrew python3 (>=3.10, for the `X | None` type syntax) -- the system /usr/bin/python3 is too old on at least one node (3.9.6), see agent/README.md.
